subject: Using methylkit filter out signal from another sample

messages.author: ff2c1ec4d8c9fad5
messages.subject: Using methylkit filter out signal from another sample
parts:
Hello all,

I have whole genome bisulfite sequencing for two cell populations. One of my cell populations has one cell population (Pop1), while my second cell population has a mixture of two cells (Pop2) including cells from my first population. Is there a way to subtract the signal of differential methylation of my Pop1 from my Pop2?

Thanks for your help!

messages.author: a413e6cf6c4ea2cc
messages.subject: Re: Using methylkit filter out signal from another sample
parts:
Hi Yumary,

Not sure if this works, but you might achieve this using the `adjustMethylC` function (https://rdrr.io/bioc/methylKit/man/adjustMethylC.html).
Please also check the forum for related discussions (https://groups.google.com/g/methylkit_discussion/search?q=adjustmethylc). 

Best, 
Alex
